role: point membership in an open parameter

role: unary point predicate corresponding to a modal letter
notes: Interpretation is nu(p); not assumed open or closed.

role: basis cover axiom

role: empty basis-element axiom

role: local intersection refinement axiom

role: standard modal-to-topological translation

role: ideal of allowed box support subsets

role: factor point structure

role: factor topology
notes: Contains empty and whole carrier.

notes: This ordinary basis need not contain empty before it is explicitly adjoined.

role: basic image family of the open quotient map

role: canonical coordinate projection of an actual basic box

role: filter agreement congruence of index subsets

role: Boolean complement of an index class

role: predicate for the support ideal

role: Boolean algebra and ideal theory
